description: Two mixers, each summing up to six inputs, with a normal and an inverted output

params.text: Switches that section between adding its patched inputs together and averaging them

inputs.text: One of the six signals summed by that section

outputs.text: The sum of that section's patched inputs
The sum of that section's patched inputs with its polarity flipped

notes: a section reads only the first channel of a polyphonic input, and its outputs are monophonic
menu: Merge channels 1 & 2 — sums both sections together, so all twelve inputs arrive at both pairs of outputs
